headline: Marketing & Communications Manager | B2B Strategy, PR & Growth
summary: Results-driven Marketing & Communications Manager with a Bachelor of Business Administration and extensive experience in strategic brand positioning and B2B campaign execution. Proven track record in translating complex technical solutions into compelling value propositions for regional and international markets. Expert in managing integrated marketing and PR strategies, including media relations, thought leadership events, and multi-channel campaign management. Skilled in driving brand presence, optimizing marketing budgets for maximum ROI, and leading cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact communications across MENA and global audiences.

experience.title: Growth & Digital Marketing Manager
bullets: Led integrated B2B marketing and PR strategies for high-growth financial platforms, successfully translating complex technical offerings into clear, compelling value propositions for institutional and retail audiences.
Managed multi-channel marketing campaigns across MENA, EU, and Asian markets, driving significant brand awareness and lead generation through strategic media buying and targeted content distribution.
Built and maintained relationships with key journalists, media outlets, and industry influencers, resulting in increased press coverage and enhanced brand credibility in competitive sectors.
Coordinated industry events, product launches, and executive speaking opportunities, positioning the brand as a thought leader and driving high-quality engagement with key stakeholders.
Monitored industry trends and campaign KPIs, optimizing marketing budgets to maximize ROI and ensure alignment with broader business growth objectives.

experience.title: Community & Marketing Manager
bullets: Developed and executed strategic communications plans to elevate brand presence, focusing on consistent messaging across digital channels and offline touchpoints.
Managed user growth and engagement through targeted AMA campaigns and KOL relations, fostering a strong community and driving adoption in the MENA and European markets.
Collaborated with product and engineering teams to create accurate and engaging content that highlighted technical innovations and user benefits.
Tracked campaign performance and adjusted strategies based on data insights, ensuring efficient use of resources and improved conversion rates.

cover_letter: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Marketing & Communications Manager role at WAJJAD. With a background in B2B marketing and strategic communications, I have successfully positioned complex tech solutions as industry leaders in the MENA and international markets. My experience in media relations, campaign management, and thought leadership aligns perfectly with Omana's goal of driving regional growth through digital infrastructure. I am eager to bring my expertise in translating technical value into compelling narratives to your team in Cairo.

screening.q: Do you have experience in B2B marketing and strategic communications?
screening.a: Yes, I have extensive experience leading B2B marketing strategies and managing strategic communications for technology-driven platforms in the financial and crypto sectors.

screening.q: Are you available to work on-site full-time in Cairo, Egypt?
screening.a: Yes, I am based in Cairo, Egypt, and fully available for on-site, full-time work.

screening.q: Do you have a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field?
screening.a: Yes, I hold a Bachelor of Business Administration.

screening.q: Can you translate technical offerings into clear value propositions?
screening.a: Absolutely. I have a proven track record of bridging the gap between technical teams and marketing to create clear, compelling value propositions for complex digital solutions.
